title: kaijutsu Skill Manifest
description: Schema for skill.yaml — the per-skill metadata file consumed by the jutsu CLI.

name.description: Lowercase-kebab-case skill identifier; must match the SKILL.md frontmatter name.

license.description: SPDX license identifier. Must be MIT or in the configured allowlist (BSD-2-Clause, BSD-3-Clause, ISC, Apache-2.0).

layout.description: flat = SKILL.md + scripts/. rich = Anthropic progressive-disclosure layout with references/, runbooks/, scripts/, assets/, subagents/.

description.description: Single-sentence summary used by jutsu search and info.

upstream.description: Optional. URL of the original source for adapted/ported skills (e.g. the upstream addyosmani/agent-skills SKILL.md). Recorded for attribution alongside `author`.

agents.description: Which agents this skill has been authored / tested for.

shared.description: Rich layout only: top-level dirs that are agent-agnostic and shared across install targets.

bash.description: Whether the skill executes shell commands.

network.description: Whether the skill makes network requests.

fs-write.description: false = read-only; 'scoped' = writes limited to the user's project tree and agent state dirs (.claude/, .codex/, .gemini/, .agents/); 'full' = unrestricted writes anywhere on disk.

hooks.description: Whether the skill ships agent hooks (entries in skill.yaml `hooks:` that get registered into the agent's settings file at install time). Required to be true when the skill declares any hooks.

expected-signer.description: GitHub identity (e.g. kaijutsu-core@github) the CLI will verify the Sigstore bundle against. Authors do NOT self-assert signed=true; the CLI derives it from successful cosign verify-blob.

hooks.description: Agent hooks that the CLI registers into the target agent's settings file at install time. Each entry is translated to the agent-native format (Claude/Gemini: JSON in settings.json; Codex: TOML in config.toml).

id.description: Unique-within-skill identifier; part of the kaijutsu marker so re-installs update prior entries instead of duplicating.

event.description: Canonical kaijutsu event name. The CLI translates each per-agent: pre-tool-use → Claude PreToolUse / Codex PreToolUse / Gemini BeforeTool, etc. Events with no per-agent equivalent are skipped on that agent with a warning.

matcher.description: Filter expression. Tool name (e.g. 'Bash') for Claude/Gemini; expression syntax (e.g. "tool_name == 'shell_command'") for Codex. Pass through unmodified to the target settings file.

script.description: Path inside the skill directory (e.g. 'hooks/dcg.sh'). Resolved against the install location at hook-register time.

can_block.description: Whether the hook may block the triggering action. Default true for pre-* events, false for post-* / notification.
